name: TenderYes
tagline: Detects whether a legal message contains a settlement tender and routes it to the right AI specialist.

awards: Tender for Lawyers Sponsored By Morgan & Morgan

problem: Lawyers receive messy inputs where actionable tenders hide.
solution: Accepts text or PDF, detects a tender, and routes to specialists that draft client emails at three formality levels or research the issue.
demo_moment: Team-described: paste a message and get three draft replies.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Tender for Lawyers Sponsored By Morgan & Morgan” among 112 submissions.
Follows the sponsor's orchestrator brief closely.

lessons: Matching a detailed sponsor brief step by step is a reliable path to its prize.
